invariants.rule: Stages exchange content-addressed artifacts; model text never directly mutates runtime state.
Every model-authored artifact receives deterministic structural and reference validation.
A failed model boundary receives at most one repair before clarification or rejection.
No producer is the final verifier of its own output.
A node passes only when its deterministic gate and independent evaluator both accept the same artifact generation.
Runtime commands read the frozen run contract, never mutable repository contract files.
Only typed envelopes can drive failure classification and operator state changes.
Independent EvidenceIR is the only path to a green run or workflow promotion.
A field exists only when a named consumer makes a decision that can change from its value.
